name: smart-attendance-system-workspace
description: Multi-layer AI-powered Smart Attendance System workspace CLI & runner

scripts.dev:backend: node -e "const path = require('path'); const fs = require('fs'); const { execSync } = require('child_process'); const backendDir = path.resolve('backend'); const venvPythonPosix = path.join(backendDir, '.venv', 'bin', 'python'); const venvPythonWin = path.join(backendDir, '.venv', 'Scripts', 'python.exe'); let pythonExec; if (fs.existsSync(venvPythonPosix)) pythonExec = venvPythonPosix; else if (fs.existsSync(venvPythonWin)) pythonExec = venvPythonWin; else pythonExec = process.platform === 'win32' ? 'python' : 'python3'; execSync(pythonExec, ['-m', 'uvicorn', 'main:app', '--reload', '--port', '8000'], {stdio: 'inherit'})";
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
